text: `doc/man_docs.go` implements man-page generation. `GenMan` fills a default header, renders the command through `genMan` and `md2man.Render`, and writes it to the supplied writer (`doc/man_docs.go:103-116`). `fillHeader` supplies title, section, date—including `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH` support—and an autogenerated source label (`doc/man_docs.go:118-141`).
